src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) if row_bounds[i]+1 < row_bounds[i+1]]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1) if col_bounds[i]+1 < col_bounds[i+1]]
    sepvals = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    out = [[bg for _ in col_spans] for _ in row_spans]
    for i, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for j, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            found = False
            for a in range(r1-r0):
                for b in range(c1-c0):
                    v = tile[a][b]
                    if v == bg or v in sepvals:
                        continue
                    if (b+1 < c1-c0 and tile[a][b+1] == v) or (a+1 < r1-r0 and tile[a+1][b] == v):
                        found = True
            if found:
                out[i][j] = 1
    return out
'''
